task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Grab the glazed bowl with curved sides, then carefully place the ceramic bowl with earthy brown trim on top.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高度稳定性，不变形，进入框架抓住弧形釉面碗，然后小心地将土棕色镶边的陶瓷碗放在上面。
